global: A bowl of spicy ramen with rich, reddish broth and tender chashu pork. Topped with shredded green onions and fresh herbs, it sits in a white ceramic bowl on a dark tray, under warm, ambient lighting.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and slight sheen, bordered by black tray edges.
regions.bowl: Cream-colored ceramic bowl with smooth, slightly glossy surface and subtle speckled pattern along its rim.
regions.soup: The spicy broth is vibrant red-orange, glossy, and swirling around thin noodles, topped with shredded greens and meat.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows glistening, tender texture with golden-brown sear and visible fat marbling on its curved surface.
